project_name: Crafters Market - Grow With Us Page
emotional_goal: Something important is being built here early — and I can still become part of it.
core_strategy: Selling momentum, vision, belonging, future opportunity, creator empowerment.

labels.font_family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

visual_features.surfaces: Frosted glass cards with backdrop-blur-xl and 1px border-white/10.
visual_features.hover_states: Hover depth via slight negative Y translation (-translate-y-1) and enhanced border glow.
visual_features.motion: Subtle particle movement, staggered Framer Motion reveals for sections, smooth parallax scrolling.
visual_features.accents: Glowing borders and animated gradients using cyan and orange.
visual_features.backgrounds: Grid overlays, blueprint/CNC visual language, dark matte background.

layout_strategy.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, py-24, py-32 to create breathing room.
layout_strategy.grid: Bento grids for Vision and Who We're Looking For. Asymmetrical layouts for high visual interest.
layout_strategy.container: Max width 7xl for content, edge-to-edge for backgrounds.

sections.title: Hero
sections.headline: The Next Generation Marketplace for Independent Creators
sections.supporting_copy: Crafters Market is building a creator-first ecosystem for CNC makers, artisans, designers, and modern handmade brands — combining commerce, community, and AI-powered growth tools into one platform.
sections.visual: Layered floating panels showing dashboard mockups over an ambient CNC/sparks/laser footage backdrop. Use Framer Motion for parallax and 3D floating effect.
sections.brand_cues: Include '◆ GROW WITH US' as monospace tracking-[0.28em] orange label above headline.

sections.title: The Problem
sections.headline: Makers Deserve Better Platforms
sections.content: LEFT: Oversaturated marketplace (cluttered, low visibility, generic listings, rising fees). RIGHT: Curated maker ecosystem (AI-assisted growth, community visibility, transparent fees).
sections.visual: Use contrasting UI blocks or stylized text/metrics to represent the chaos vs. the curated ecosystem.

implementation_instructions.file_structure: Create as a single page component at `/src/pages/GrowWithUs.jsx` or equivalent router component, and break complex sections (like Hero mockups and Roadmap timeline) into smaller local components.
implementation_instructions.styling: Use Tailwind CSS extensively. For glassmorphism, use `bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10`. For glowing accents, use `shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,69,0,0.5)]` or similar.
implementation_instructions.animations: Use Framer Motion for section reveals (`initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}` -> `animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}`). Implement parallax using `useScroll` and `useTransform` on the hero dashboard mockups.
implementation_instructions.testing: Ensure all buttons and links have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="hero-primary-cta"`).
